description: This file defines a configuration class `VertexAILlama3Config` for interfacing with VertexAI's Llama API, including methods for handling parameters, response transformation, and logging.

classes.name: VertexAILlama3Config
classes.description: Configuration class for VertexAI's Llama API, extending OpenAIGPTConfig with additional parameter handling and response transformation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the configuration object, setting max_tokens if provided.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of class attributes excluding functions and special attributes.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Retrieves supported OpenAI parameters, removing 'max_retries' if present.

methods.name: transform_response
methods.description: Logs the response, parses JSON, handles errors, and updates the model response object.
